test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 3: COURSE LIFECYCLE MANAGEMENT - DELETING A COURSE
test_cases.test_case_title: Teacher Confirms Course Deletion after Enabling Deletion
test_cases.pre_condition: A Teacher with the email 'GiangGiangteacher@gmail.com' and password 'NewSecurePass123!' is logged into the system and is on the Dashboard Page. The course 'Temporary Course for Deletion' exists and the 'Modify Course' modal is open with the 'Allow Deletion' checkbox checked and the 'Delete' button enabled.
test_cases.expected_result: The system displays a final confirmation dialog, warning that this action is irreversible and all course-related data (sessions, files, student lists, forum posts, etc.) will be permanently deleted. The outcome is successful (True).
test_cases.post_condition: The confirmation dialog is displayed, awaiting the Teacher's final decision to delete the course.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Delete' button in the 'Modify Course' modal.

test_data_fields.field_name: Modify Course Modal Deletion Controls_Allow Deletion

test_cases.groups_involved: Edit Course Initiation, Modify Course Modal Deletion Controls, Deletion Confirmation Dialog
